paper.citation: Dikkala, N., Lewis, G., Mackey, L. and Syrgkanis, V. (2020). Minimax Estimation of Conditional Moment Models. NeurIPS 33:12248-12262.
paper.source_version: NeurIPS 2020 published paper and supplemental; author code commit 691fbe0761ee5b40dbc4e38317946a7193186af2
paper.source_locator: Supplement Appendix J, printed p.48 (supplement PDF p.33), sine h0 and first-stage equations; Fig.15 printed p.50 for nx=nz=1, alpha=.6. Author mliv/dgps.py lines 53-54 and 154-163; standardize at 89-95.

mechanism.name: IV: sine structural response with Gaussian confounding

sampling.dependence: iid individuals; exogenous random draws mutually independent within individual except explicitly shared latent errors

assumptions: iid individuals, consistency and no interference.
Z is independent of U,delta,zeta; Z enters Y only through P (exclusion).
E[U+zeta|Z]=0; nonzero instrument_strength gives a relevant Gaussian location first stage.
Identification uses an appropriate integrable structural-response class and Gaussian convolution injectivity/completeness; zero instrument strength would remove identification.

properties.notes: No pretreatment covariates; Z1 is an instrument and P an endogenous treatment. h0(P)=sin(P) is nonlinear. One instrument and one treatment, not a high-dimensional design.

estimand.name: theta_IV = h0(0.5)-h0(0)
estimand.definition: Structural outcome contrast for interventions P=.5 versus P=0, retaining the marginal centered latent confounder and outcome noise. This is not E[Y|P=.5]-E[Y|P=0].

truth.expression: Structural outcome contrast for interventions P=.5 versus P=0, retaining the marginal centered latent confounder and outcome noise. This is not E[Y|P=.5]-E[Y|P=0].
truth.derivation: Analytic sine contrast; independent composite Simpson integration of cosine at orders 512 and 1024, plus Gaussian residual-moment quadrature.

adaptations: Use the author-code Gaussian-location branch (lines 154-162), one endogenous treatment and one instrument, h0(x)=sin(x), alpha=.6; draw SD(Z)=SD(U)=2 and SD(delta)=SD(zeta)=.1. This resolves the paper Normal second-parameter ambiguity by code, and is not a variance-2 paper-only reproduction.
Omit author-code sample-dependent centering/scaling of Y and h0 (lines 89-95,163), retaining raw structural units and an iid population estimand independent of realized sample.
Collect scalar structural contrast h0(.5)-h0(0) instead of a full response-surface estimator; no population binary ATE or conditional regression is claimed.
Use local PCG64 and n=128, seed=1729 for interface checking, without fitting the original estimators.
